cards.ex: We need policies to level the playing field for small businesses.
cards.exUz: Bizga kichik bizneslar uchun sharoitlarni tenglashtiradigan siyosat kerak.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatda hamma uchun adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar yaratmoq.

cards.ex: India is a major emerging market for tech companies.
cards.exUz: Hindiston texnologiya kompaniyalari uchun katta rivojlanayotgan bozor hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Tez o'sayotgan iqtisodiyotga ega bo'lgan davlat bozori.

cards.ex: The EU and Canada have a free trade agreement.
cards.exUz: Yevropa Ittifoqi va Kanada erkin savdo shartnomasiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Davlatlar o'rtasida savdoni osonlashtiruvchi shartnoma.

cards.ex: The pandemic disrupted the global supply chain.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya global ta'minot zanjirini buzdi.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulot ishlab chiqarish uchun zarur bo'lgan butlovchi qismlar va materiallar global tarmog'i.

cards.ex: Tariffs are a common type of trade barrier.
cards.exUz: Tariflar - savdo to'siqlarining keng tarqalgan turi.
cards.uzDef: Import yoki eksportga xalaqit beradigan hukumat siyosati.

cards.ex: Many companies are outsourcing customer service to India.
cards.exUz: Ko'p kompaniyalar mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatishni Hindistonga autsorsing qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning boshqa kompaniyaga ishni topshirishi.

cards.ex: Protectionism can hurt global trade.
cards.exUz: Proteksionizm global savdoga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Milliy iqtisodiyotni himoya qilish siyosati.

cards.ex: The economic downturn affected many businesses.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy tanazzul ko'plab bizneslarga ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiyotda yomonlashuv, pasayish davri.

cards.ex: China has a large trade surplus with the US.
cards.exUz: Xitoy AQSh bilan katta savdo profitsitiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Eksport importdan ko'p bo'lganda.

cards.ex: Vietnam has a comparative advantage in textiles.
cards.exUz: Vetnam to'qimachilikda qiyosiy ustunlikka ega.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotni arzonroq ishlab chiqarish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: They accused the company of dumping steel on the market.
cards.exUz: Ular kompaniyani bozorda po'latni dumpingda ayblashdi.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulotni arzon narxlarda sotish, bozorni egallash uchun.

cards.ex: The company decided to go global to increase its profits.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya foydani oshirish uchun globallashishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xalqaro bozorlarga chiqish, global miqyosda faoliyat yuritish.

cards.ex: I only buy fair trade coffee.
cards.exUz: Men faqat adolatli savdo qahvasini sotib olaman.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanayotgan davlatlar bilan adolatli narxlarda savdo qilish.

cards.ex: The tax increase had a knock-on effect on consumer spending.
cards.exUz: Soliqning oshishi iste'mol xarajatlariga zanjir reaksiyasini keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Bir voqeaning boshqa narsalarga ketma-ket ta'siri.

cards.ex: The new regulations will affect our bottom line.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar bizning asosiy natijaga ta'sir qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning sof foydasi yoki zarari.

cards.ex: The company had to cut costs to stay competitive.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya raqobatbardosh bo'lish uchun xarajatlarni qisqartirishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: They are trying to increase their market share.
cards.exUz: Ular bozor ulushini oshirishga harakat qilmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning bozordagi umumiy sotuvlaridagi foiz ulushi.

cards.ex: The government imposed tariffs on imported steel.
cards.exUz: Hukumat import qilinadigan po'latga bojlar qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Import qilinadigan tovarlarga solinadigan soliq.

cards.ex: The trade war between the US and China is escalating.
cards.exUz: AQSh va Xitoy o'rtasidagi savdo urushi kuchaymoqda.
cards.uzDef: Davlatlar o'rtasida savdo to'siqlarini ko'paytirish bo'yicha janjal.

cards.ex: The internet has made the world a global village.
cards.exUz: Internet dunyoni global qishloqqa aylantirdi.
cards.uzDef: Texnologiya tufayli dunyoning qisqarishi va yaqinlashuvi.

cards.ex: Companies need to innovate to stay competitive.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyalar raqobatbardosh bo'lish uchun innovatsiya qilishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bozorda muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish uchun o'zgarishlarga moslashmoq.

cards.ex: The country has a negative balance of trade.
cards.exUz: Mamlakatda salbiy savdo balansi mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Davlatning eksport va importi o'rtasidagi farq.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha bizneslar uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatda hamma uchun teng imkoniyatlar.

cards.ex: They want to avoid a trade war at all costs.
cards.exUz: Ular har qanday narxda savdo urushining oldini olishni xohlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga erishish uchun hamma narsaga tayyor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Mass production allows for economies of scale.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy ishlab chiqarish miqyos iqtisodiyotiga imkon beradi.
cards.uzDef: Ishlab chiqarish hajmi oshishi bilan xarajatlarning kamayishi.

cards.ex: The company has a significant global footprint.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning sezilarli global izi bor.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning dunyo bo'ylab ta'siri.

cards.ex: Innovation gives them a competitive edge.
cards.exUz: Innovatsiya ularga raqobat ustunligini beradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ajralib turadigan, ustunlik beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: Consumer demand is rising for electric vehicles.
cards.exUz: Elektr transport vositalariga bo'lgan iste'mol talabi oshmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Iste'molchilarning tovar va xizmatlarga bo'lgan ehtiyoji.

cards.ex: The US has a large trade deficit with China.
cards.exUz: AQShning Xitoy bilan katta savdo defitsiti bor.
cards.uzDef: Import eksportdan ko'p bo'lganda.

cards.ex: Tariff barriers can restrict international trade.
cards.exUz: Boj to'siqlari xalqaro savdoni cheklashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Import qilinadigan tovarlarga solinadigan yuqori bojlar.
